title: Feature create/edit form
discoveries: TanStack Form mode='array' pattern for dynamic list fields
Sheet modal integration with form components
Array field validation with min/max constraints
Zod validation integration with form error rendering
what_worked_well: Pattern reuse from sign-up-form.tsx accelerated implementation
TanStack Form array fields work as documented - pushValue/removeValue simple to use
Sheet component abstraction makes form modal integration clean
Zod validators inline with form fields enable real-time validation feedback
Query cache invalidation pattern from F023 reused successfully
what_failed: Iteration 1: Type safety issues - used unsafe 'as unknown as Feature' cast instead of proper typing
Iteration 1-2: Array index as React key in error messages caused warnings
Iteration 1-2: SVG accessibility - missing title element in close button
Iteration 2: Filter accepted empty strings in acceptance criteria array
root_causes: Local type definition (FeatureFromAPI) instead of importing from shared package - caused drift from actual API response shape
Copied error message rendering pattern without updating key generation
SVG accessibility patterns not familiar - needed title element inside SVG, not aria-label on wrapper
recommendations_for_next: Create FeatureSelect export in @nomos-ai/db and use throughout frontend to eliminate type duplication
Extract form field components into reusable validation + error rendering component to avoid copy-paste errors
Add UI component accessibility checklist before QA (SVG needs title, inputs need labels, etc.)
Consider form generation from Zod schema to reduce boilerplate (zod-form-data or similar)
